\label{lesson:IT-C120-tigre}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: la tigre}
\textbf{la tigre} — \textquotedblleft{}a tiger\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{tigre} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{tigris}, \textquotedblleft{}tiger\textquotedblright{}, which Latin took from Greek \emph{tigris}. EtymDB 2.1 has no row for \emph{tigre}; it derives Spanish and Portuguese \emph{tigre} from \emph{tigris}.
\end{cousinweb}
